products.description:

products.title: Wilson Courtglide White White White - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON COURTGLIDE WHITE WHITE WHITE - The new padel shoes perfect for everyday life. You can use them both casually and for intensive use on the track. Wilson Padel has launched its new line of padel footwear for the 2026 season. These new WILSON COURTGLIDE WHITE WHITE WHITE are a basic model in white, vintage style, a safe bet within Wilson's mid-range. This model is designed to offer the player high comfort and stability.

They incorporate advanced technologies, such as the Duralast rubber sole, with a type of pattern similar to clay, optimized for padel, which provides us with constant traction on the court, helping to make more controlled changes of direction and stable movements.

The R-DST midsole balances cushioning and response. It absorbs impacts without disconnecting the player from the ground, allowing a natural and comfortable footprint during training and recreational matches.

We recommend them for players who are starting or have an intermediate level. Without a doubt, a shoe that, due to its design, attracts a lot of attention to be worn even on a daily basis.
